 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD  ORDER % 13.08.2024 CRL.M.A. 23612/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. The Petitioner has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in FIR No.45/2023 dated 22.01.2023, registered at Police Station Anand Parbat for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/304B/34 IPC.

2. When this Court made a suggestion to the learned Counsel appearing for the Petitioner that the Petitioner can approach the Competent Court for grant of bail after the mother, father and brother of the deceased are examined, the learned Counsel for the Petitioner graciously accepts the suggestion and seeks permission to withdraw the present bail application with liberty to approach the Competent Court for grant of bail after the mother, father and brother of the deceased will be examined.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/08/2024 at 20:35:33 3.
Permission and liberty, as sought for, are granted.

4. The Trial Court is requested to ensure that the examination of the three witnesses i.e., mother,
father and brother of the deceased, is concluded as expeditiously as possible, preferably within two months from today.
